variable.u.y * ((math.cos((math.floor(variable.particle_random_1 * variable.m) * 360 / variable.m)) * variable.r) * math.cos((variable.rot + variable.spin * variable.particle_age)) - (math.sin((math.floor(variable.particle_random_1 * variable.m) * 360 / variable.m)) * variable.r) * math.sin((variable.rot + variable.spin * variable.particle_age))) + variable.v.y * ((math.cos((math.floor(variable.particle_random_1 * variable.m) * 360 / variable.m)) * variable.r) * math.sin((variable.rot + variable.spin * variable.particle_age)) + (math.sin((math.floor(variable.particle_random_1 * variable.m) * 360 / variable.m)) * variable.r) * math.cos((variable.rot + variable.spin * variable.particle_age)))

variable.u.z * ((math.cos((math.floor(variable.particle_random_1 * variable.m) * 360 / variable.m)) * variable.r) * math.cos((variable.rot + variable.spin * variable.particle_age)) - (math.sin((math.floor(variable.particle_random_1 * variable.m) * 360 / variable.m)) * variable.r) * math.sin((variable.rot + variable.spin * variable.particle_age))) + variable.v.z * ((math.cos((math.floor(variable.particle_random_1 * variable.m) * 360 / variable.m)) * variable.r) * math.sin((variable.rot + variable.spin * variable.particle_age)) + (math.sin((math.floor(variable.particle_random_1 * variable.m) * 360 / variable.m)) * variable.r) * math.cos((variable.rot + variable.spin * variable.particle_age)))
